plan: Model adaptation as a pure function: deep-copy the recipe into a working structure so inputs are never mutated and the original stays printable byte-for-byte via authored_text passthrough.

Resolve dietary exclusions per ingredient with a while-loop plus a per-chain name set: pick the catalog candidate ranked by (priority, catalog order), rewrite name/quantity/unit/preparation, and detect cycles or missing substitutions as recorded reasons instead of aborting.

Queue catalog-introduced additional ingredients (FIFO), each inheriting a copy of its parent chain, so reintroduced exclusions are re-substituted or reported as cycles and chained adaptations terminate.

Accumulate side effects (wording_changes, equipment additions/removals, yield factors, warnings, ordered choice IDs) during resolution; apply them in one finalization pass: set arithmetic + sort for equipment, ordered str.replace over all instruction strings, and a single Fraction scale target_yield / (yield * yield_factors) over every quantity.

Collect every independently applicable failure reason (no substitution for NAME, substitution cycle involving NAME, equipment NAME unavailable) into a set and emit sorted; return recipe=null on impossibility, otherwise the fully adapted recipe with sorted warnings and empty reasons.

Ship an executable acceptance suite under __main__ exercising 3->5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment wording change, reintroduced exclusion, cycle detection, simultaneous multiple reasons, exact original printing with non-mutation checks, and priority-based determinism.
mechanisms: deep-copied working model for input immutability
(priority, catalog-index) ranked candidate selection for deterministic choice
per-ingredient chain sets for cycle and reintroduction detection
FIFO queue of additional ingredients inheriting parent chains
accumulated delta lists (wording, equipment, yield, warnings) applied in a finalization pass
single late Fraction scaling pass combining yield change and substitution factors
reason set with sorted emission for exhaustive impossibility reporting
authored_text passthrough for byte-exact original printing
